title: Add website template: database config
description: Create a PHP database configuration file that establishes a PDO connection using environment variables. Connection errors should be thrown, not silently ignored.
acceptanceCriteria: Connection uses DB_HOST, DB_NAME, DB_USER, DB_PASS environment variables
Throws an exception on connection error (does not suppress errors)

steps.details: Create src/templates/website/config/database.php: <?php function getDB(): PDO { static $pdo = null; if ($pdo !== null) return $pdo; $host = getenv('DB_HOST') ?: 'localhost'; $name = getenv('DB_NAME') ?: 'app'; $user = getenv('DB_USER') ?: 'root'; $pass = getenv('DB_PASS') ?: ''; $dsn = "mysql:host={$host};dbname={$name};charset=utf8mb4"; $pdo = new PDO($dsn, $user, $pass, [PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION, PDO::ATTR_DEFAULT_FETCH_MODE => PDO::FETCH_ASSOC]); return $pdo; }
Review the file and confirm all credentials come from getenv() calls. No hardcoded passwords, usernames, or database names except default fallbacks like 'localhost' and 'app'.

technicalNotes: PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION causes PDO to throw PDOException on errors instead of returning false
The static $pdo pattern implements a simple singleton connection pool to avoid reconnecting on every request
charset=utf8mb4 is required for full Unicode support (including emojis) — do not use utf8
